comments.text:
In HDFC Life Click 2 Achieve Par Advantage, surrendering early usually gives a lower amount.
This plan is meant for long-term or lifetime benefits, so the full value comes only when you continue for the complete term.
Before maturity, you get only the surrender value — which is often less than the total premiums paid.
Always check the Benefit Illustration before buying, because it clearly shows the exact surrender value for every policy year.
